quarterly_data.quarter: Sanken Electric semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): consolidated net sales JPY 41,011 million, down JPY 31,780 million (43.7%), mainly because Allegro MicroSystems left consolidation in August 2024; Sanken Core sales fell 11.8% as automotive, the main market, held firm but white-goods share fell on intensified competition in China. Operating loss JPY 916 million (prior-year H1 loss JPY 5,658 million) as fixed-cost cuts and the back-end production reorganization offset lower sales and higher material prices; ordinary loss JPY 837 million; net loss attributable to owners of the parent JPY 1,397 million. H1 R&D expenses JPY 2,563 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 41,011 million (-43.7%); Sanken Core sales -11.8%; operating loss JPY 916 million
